summary.implementedScope: Resumed after attempt 003's provider crash, which had left a complete in-tree implementation. Verified it against the story, tech design (Flows 5/6, §Mechanics, DD-8), and test plan: messages.deleteMessage and turns.deleteTurn stamp deleted_at on projection rows only (events untouched), share Story 5's cascade via a drop-vs-clear parameterized core (deleted subject's forms DELETE'd, upward forms cleared+re-queued at the next source version, queued items superseded), prompt protection refuses initiating-prompt deletes with message_initiates_turn naming the turn and both turns-delete paths, empty chunks drop their summary forms with no rebuild queued, and the deleted-read filter covers message reads, turn reads, membership, chunk member loads, and composition inputs (proven by captureInputs in TC-6.5). Completed the unfinished tail: rebuilt dist (parity tests had failed only on a stale build), recorded the two new test files in the red-manifest per project convention, and added the new process-suite file to vitest.config.ts's exclusion list so it runs under verify-all only. Both gates green.
